0022600231.text: The Nuggets (5-4, 3-2 on the road) come in on a one-game losing streak, sitting 10th in the West and 2 games back in the Northwest, while the Pelicans (4-7) have dropped three straight and are 12th in the West. Denver leads the 2026-27 season series 2-0 after a 104-91 win in New Orleans on October 28, and it also won all three meetings in 2025-26. Julian Strawther is out for Denver with a knee sprain, and Yves Missi is out for New Orleans with a knee bruise.
